text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency spike detected for hosted/streaming endpoint `redwood-chat-v2` across us-west-2. Rolling 5m p99 jumped from 420ms -> 1.9s and streaming stalls observed. Auto-paging threshold exceeded.
Rosa (oncall): seeing it in the console too. traces show long stalls during token emission (stall at kv-cache dequant step).
Mike SRE: I'm on the bridge. Paging SREs and infra. Starting impact assessment.
Zach (ML): likely linked to the int8 calibration rollout we promoted last night. Calibration job finished at 02:10 and we started serving the int8 profile at 02:30.
Anya (PM): customers reporting degraded interactive chat — several support tickets flagged as high. Any ETA on mitigation?
Emma (infra): spinning new nodes to increase capacity, but if it's a per-request dequant stall that's not enough. Trying a quick traffic split to fallback model (fp16) now.
Mike SRE: routing rule applied: 30% -> redwood-chat-v2-fp16-fallback. Monitoring p95/p99.
Rosa (oncall): can we roll back calibration profile on the model?
Zach (ML): yes — we can disable the int8 calibration profile at serving layer. Pushing disable flag to model config in control plane. Command: `rdctl models update redwood-chat-v2 --disable-precision int8-calib`
Emma (infra): applied flag. Confirming no new int8 slots allocated.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: config change applied by Emma at 1806123520.
Mike SRE: p99 dropped to 780ms after config flip, p95 near baseline. Streaming stalls reduced but not fully gone; still seeing sporadic 1.2-1.5s tails.
Zach (ML): there might be residual warmed kernels or quantized caches triggering slow paths. We should clear model warm state and restart a subset of workers to purge bad kernels.
Rosa (oncall): please coordinate restarts during ramp — avoid mass restart to prevent spike. Do rolling restart across 6 worker groups.
Emma (infra): starting rolling restart now. Command: `infra restart-workers --group=redwood-chat-v2 --parallel=1`
Mike SRE: also enabling extra request-level timeouts to avoid stuck streaming connections: `stream.timeout_ms=8000` and add early-return on stalled kv dequant.
Support Bot: Notifying customers on status.redwood.ai incident page. Posting update to affected customers list.
Anya (PM): draft status: "We're investigating increased latency on streaming chat. We've rolled back a recent model precision change and are doing targeted restarts. No data exposure; some interactive sessions may experience brief delays." I'll post after you confirm stability.
Zach (ML): after two worker groups restarted, p99 stable at ~420-500ms. However one pool still showing p99 ~1.1s; digging into its logs. Found repeated `dequant::kernel_timeout` entries and GPU mem pressure spikes during larger context requests.
Mike SRE: isolating that pool and draining traffic to spare capacity. `infra drain --pool=pool-7-redwood-chat-v2`
incident-bot: pool-7 drained at 1806123725.
Rosa (oncall): good containment. What about rollback sweep for customers that saw errors? Do we need retroactive token-level analysis?
Zach (ML): recommend post-incident eval on calibration profile metrics: per-batch dequant latency histograms, kernel fallback counts, and KV cache invalidation rates. We'll tag all requests that used int8-calib in the last 6 hours for evaluation.
Anya (PM): I'll coordinate customer comms and offer targeted remediation for impacted enterprise orgs. Also we should consider temporarily disabling auto-promote for calibrations.
Emma (infra): adding an alert for surge in `dequant::fallback_count` + `gpu_mem_pressure` so we catch this earlier.
Mike SRE: incident severity -> Sev2 for now (service degraded, customer impact non-critical but visible). Logging timeline and metrics.
Rosa (oncall): handing over to Mike for the follow-on remediation and postmortem draft. I'll stay available for escalation.
Mike SRE: taking over on-call. Next steps: 1) confirm all pools stable for 30m; 2) collect traces and logs for affected windows; 3) revert any lingering config promoting int8; 4) schedule postmortem with ML and infra tomorrow.
Zach (ML): I'll prepare calibration artifact review — the calibration sample set, distribution shift checks, and kernel compatibility matrix for int8. Early hypothesis: calibration introduced kernel codepath that regresses under wide context lengths due to KV dequant ordering.
Anya (PM): add action item: disable auto-promote for precision calibration until we have guardrails and can A/B test at lower traffic.
incident-bot: Incident update posted to #incidents at 1806123810.
Support Bot: Affected customers who opened tickets have been notified with initial statement.
Rosa (oncall): thanks everyone. Mike, please @me on the postmortem when ready. Closing live page once stable 30m and p99 back to baseline.
Mike SRE: will do. Marking incident as "mitigated" for now — continuing monitoring and investigation.
